name: Separate pigments from leaf or flower extracts by paper chromatography and determine Rf values
subject: chemistry

educational_goal: Perform the Class 12 microscale chemistry experiment 'Separate pigments from leaf or flower extracts by paper chromatography and determine Rf values' and record its manual-defined observations and result.
materials: chromatography jar, cork and hook, filter paper, capillary tube, pencil, ethanol, leaf or flower extract
safety_notes: Follow the supplied manual and teacher supervision for quantities, heating, acids, bases, organic solvents, and waste disposal.
Wear eye protection and do not taste or directly handle chemicals.
